# Test fixtures

`GeoIP2-Country-Test.mmdb` is copied unmodified from MaxMind's public
[MaxMind-DB test-data](https://github.com/maxmind/MaxMind-DB/tree/main/test-data)
repository (`test-data/GeoIP2-Country-Test.mmdb`), used under that repository's
license. It is a synthetic database for testing only - it is not a real
GeoLite2/GeoIP2 database and contains no real-world data beyond a handful of
well-known sample IPs (e.g. `81.2.69.142` -> `GB`, `89.160.20.128` -> `SE`,
`216.160.83.56` -> `US`).
